profile.headline: Owner, Sevan Technology
profile.summary:
PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS		

Thirteen years direct experience in the analysis, design, development, testing, quality assurance, and implementation of large-scale and elementary information systems for both regional corporations and residential clients.  Consistently effective in aligning IS strategies and architecture with consumer missions.  Qualifications include:

- Systems Analysis, Integration, & Lifecycle		- Client-Server Technology
- Hardware Troubleshooting & Installation         	- Configuration Management		
- Technology Security                                                         - Telecommunication Integration
- Installation of Operating Systems			- Technology Management
- Network Troubleshooting & Installation 		- Web Development
- Desk Top Publishing 				- Web Server Administration

Specialties: accounts payable,  accounts receivable, cat5,  clerical,  computer hardware, customer service,  data entry, database administration,dsl, file management,  graphic design, graphical user interface,  hubs, inventory management,multimedia,  networking, operating systems, payables, payroll processing, pc hardware,  printers,  purchasing,  quality control, receiving,  routers, sales, scheduling, servers, shipping,switches, troubleshooting, upgrades, web servers, web site production,  word processing,

positions.title: Computer Engineer and Web Developer
positions.description: Provide commercial and residential clients with custom built servers, workstations and personal computers.  Serve commercial and residential clients on-site service for installation, upgrades and troubleshooting for computer hardware and software.  Troubleshooting and installation of networks, CAT5, T1 and DSL drops, hubs, routers, switches and patch panels.  Implement the development and design of graphics and websites.  Installation and troubleshooting of Web servers in several different operating systems such as, Linux/Unix, Windows 2000, 2003 and 2008.  Provide web server management, development and hosting for commercial and residential clients.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant and Bookkeeper
positions.description: Transferred accounting data from old database into QuickBooks 2006.  Processed Accounts Receivable and Payable, data entry, end of the month process of accounts (purging, processing statements, payables and receivable etc.)  Clerical procedures including, filing of documentation, calculation, answering phones and customer service.

positions.title: Computer Hardware Lead and Sales Representative
positions.description: Provided knowledge and sales representation for desktop, laptop, computer hardware, accessories, protection packages and services for customers purchasing needs.  Provided training and supervision to hardware sales team.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager and Computer Engineer
positions.description: Trained and managed a computer engineering team of 5 or 7 computer technicians.  Performed maintenance and quality control inspections on printers, fax machines, scanners and multimedia devices.  Installation and troubleshooting of computer hardware and software.  Responsible for shipping, receiving and inventory control.  Handled accounts receivable and customer purchases.

positions.title: Computer Field Engineer
positions.description: Performed onsite service calls for installation and troubleshooting of PC hardware and software.  Custom built computers, workstations and servers.  Installed and configured TC/IP networks, CAT5's, hubs, routers, switches and patch panels. Responsible for office administration, appointment scheduling, clerical duties, billings and accounts receivable.

positions.title: Computer Field Engineer
positions.description: Performed onsite service calls for installation and troubleshooting of PC hardware and software.  Custom built computers, workstations and servers.  Installed and configured TC/IP networks, CAT5's, hubs, routers, switches and patch panels.  Responsible for office administration, appointment scheduling, clerical duties, billings and accounts receivable.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager and Computer Engineer
positions.description: Trained and managed a computer engineering team of 5 or 7 computer technicians.  Performed maintenance and quality control inspections on printers, fax machines, scanners and multimedia devices.  Installation and troubleshooting of computer hardware and software.  Responsible for shipping and receiving serviceable products.  Responsible for shipping, receiving and inventory control.  Handled accounts receivable and customer purchases.

positions.title: Data Entry and Graphic Design
positions.description: Graphic design and layout on Macintosh operating system for advertisement.  Web Content edit and layout with information received by customers.  Responsible for completion of the Auto Trader book at a set deadline.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant and Bookkeeper
positions.description: Maintained accurate budget, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable and shipping records.  Administered all data entry and word processing for shipping, receiving, inventory control, and maintenance reports.
